```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude Code for issue triage
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are an issue triage assistant. Analyze the issue title and body and suggest labels to apply. Output a JSON object with a single key "labels" containing an array of label names. Only use labels that exist in this repository. Do not add any other keys. Example: {"labels": ["bug", "help wanted"]}.  
            Issue title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}  
            Issue body: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
          max_turns: 1
          mcp_config: |
            {
              "issue": {
                "number": "${{ github.event.issue.number }}",
                "repo": "${{ github.repository }}"
              }
            }
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_env: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          timeout_minutes: 10

      - name: Parse labels from Claude output
        id: parse
        run: |
          # Extract the "labels" array from the JSON output
          labels_json=$(echo '${{ steps.claude.outputs.conclusion }}' | jq -r '.labels')
          # Convert array to comma-separated string
          labels=$(echo "$labels_json" | jq -r 'join(",")')
          echo "labels=$labels" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Add labels to issue
        uses: actions-ecosystem/action-add-labels@18f1af5e3544586314bbe15c0273249c770b2daf
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          labels: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.labels }}
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
```
